Description: "Store reference to profit_card container so that its border color can be updated dynamically in update_ui_data."
Instruction: "Save the fourth asset card container into `self.profit_card` to allow dynamic updating of its border in `update_ui_data`."
ReplacementContent:
"        self.profit_card = make_asset_card(ft.Icons.MONETIZATION_ON_ROUNDED, "#10b981", "浮动盈亏 Profit", self.asset_profit, bg_glow="#10b981")
        asset_grid = ft.Container(
            content=ft.Row(
                [
                    make_asset_card(ft.Icons.ACCOUNT_BALANCE_WALLET_ROUNDED, "#89b4fa", "结余 Balance", self.asset_balance),
                    make_asset_card(ft.Icons.INSERT_CHART_OUTLINED_ROUNDED, "#3b82f6", "净值 Equity", self.asset_equity),
                    make_asset_card(ft.Icons.SHIELD_ROUNDED, "#e0af68", "可用预付款 Free Margin", self.asset_margin),
                    self.profit_card,
                ],
                spacing=14,
            ),
            padding=ft.padding.only(left=16, right=16, top=14, bottom=6),
        )"
